login.title: Sign in to GSDN PMIS
login.subtitle: Enter your company email, 4-digit employee ID or registered phone. Microsoft 365 completes the sign-in.
login.label: Email, employee ID or phone
login.error: We could not sign you in. Try again.

mock.title: Microsoft 365 (mock)
mock.done: Verified. You can close this window.

employeeId.title: Link your employee ID
employeeId.body: Enter your 4-digit employee ID once. It must exist in the staff registry.
employeeId.label: Employee ID
employeeId.not_in_registry: This ID is not in the staff registry.
employeeId.duplicate: This ID is already linked to another account.

pending.title: Waiting for assignment
pending.body: Your account is linked. A System Admin must assign your role and regions before you can see anything.

myWork.title: My Work
myWork.empty_body: No task is assigned to you in your regions.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.subtitle: Everything waiting for you, in one list. Approve one by one or tick several.
approvals.note_required: A note is required to return a task.
approvals.select_one: Select an item to see its details.

stepUp.title: Re-authentication needed
stepUp.body: Final approval needs a fresh sign-in. Verify once and the action continues.

errors.precondition_failed: Someone changed this task. The list was refreshed; try again.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.

common.soon: This screen comes in a later phase.

sites.title: Sites
sites.subtitle: Every site with its position on the milestone pipeline.
sites.name: Name

site.not_found: This site does not exist or is outside your regions.
site.cluster: Cluster {{code}}: {{at}} of {{total}} sites at TE PAC (information only)

grid.title: Task grid
grid.uploaded: Template uploaded. A batch was created for review.
grid.template_rejected: The template was rejected (wrong ID or version).
grid.keys: Keyboard: arrows move, Enter edits a date or opens the task, Esc cancels.

drawer.drop: Drop a file or click to upload
drawer.absent: The holder is absent. Nothing moves automatically: the Team Lead decides whether to keep, reassign or act on behalf. The SLA keeps running.
drawer.slots_missing: Upload every mandatory document to submit.
drawer.upload_failed: The upload failed and was rolled back.
drawer.no_slots: This task has no document slots.
drawer.self_approval_note: You hold every remaining level, so this submission is the final approval. Re-authentication is required.
drawer.skip_note: Same holder on the next level: it is skipped and the task lands on level {{level}}.

matrix.title: Responsibility Matrix
matrix.subtitle: Who holds Entry, Review and Approve for each stage, register and Dismantle. Cells accept users, roles, groups or a mix.
matrix.search: Search name, ID, role or group
matrix.empty_cell: A used level needs at least one holder.
matrix.self_approval: One holder: a submission is the final approval (needs re-authentication).
matrix.publish_body: New levels apply to new tasks and open tasks not yet submitted. Re-authentication is required.
